heroHeadline: Turkey Navigates Crisis: İmamoğlu Mega-Trial Advances as PKK Peace Process Stalls
heroSubtitle: Istanbul's mass corruption trial of 413 defendants — including Mayor İmamoğlu — expands with new arrests in May 2026, while the PKK peace process declared by Öcalan in early 2025 remains frozen over reform sequencing. Turkey prepares to host NATO's July 2026 Ankara Summit amid economic pressures: inflation at 32%, lira near record lows, central bank rate at 37%.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (Reuters, BBC, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, TRT World, Euronews), institutional analyses (ICG, HRW, Freedom House), and authoritative historical scholarship.
